architecture_goal: Core extracts source-grounded evidence; Knowledge Layer composes evidence into knowledge; Runner orchestrates execution without defining evidence semantics.

evidence_analyzer.definition: Public Core producer of one coherent source-grounded evidence family.
forbidden_inputs: mutable AnalysisResult or other state shared across public analyzer executions
output of another public evidence analyzer
invariants: Analyzer output is deterministic for the same snapshot, Foundation fingerprint, version and evidence-affecting parameters.
Analyzer result does not depend on execution order of other public analyzers.
Source-understanding phases may depend on each other and share analyzer-owned internal state inside one analyzer.
Cross-evidence composition and subject-model assembly belong to Knowledge Layer.
Missing required inputs produce explicit diagnostics or failure; no hidden fallback to another analyzer.

evidence_artifact.definition: Self-describing persisted result of one independent Core evidence analyzer.
invariants: KLC imports evidence by artifact_kind and schema_version, not by task_id.
Artifact payload is independently consumable without reading another task directory.
Coverage and diagnostics are part of the contract, not optional log files.
Runtime-only values do not affect content_fingerprint.
Unsupported schema versions fail explicitly; no silent reinterpretation.

required_fields.content_fingerprint: canonical fingerprint excluding volatile runtime metadata
required_fields.diagnostics: explicit unresolved, ambiguous and failed observations

foundation.sections: declared consumed sections, empty when not used
foundation.used: whether this analyzer consumed a Foundation artifact

required_fields.payload: typed evidence payload or artifact references

evidence_runtime.definition: Core-owned registry and executor for independent typed evidence analyzers selected by artifact_kind and schema_version.
forbidden_behaviors: implicit publication from the monolithic analyze-java pipeline
compatibility adapters for legacy prepared-artifact manifest keys
invariants: Runtime dispatch is performed only by artifact_kind plus schema_version.
Task, Suite, Profile and knowledge identifiers are not analyzer selectors.
Every requested artifact must have exactly one registered analyzer.
Analyzer results are validated against core_evidence_artifact_contract/v1 before publication.
Missing registrations and invalid artifacts fail explicitly; legacy fallback and dual-write are forbidden.

foundation.definition: Immutable technical index of one repository/source snapshot, reusable by independent Core evidence analyzers.
invariants: Foundation is produced and versioned by Core.
Foundation is read-only for evidence analyzers.
Foundation identity is independent of task_id, suite_id and report profile.
Foundation contains technical source indexes, not subject knowledge.
Runner may manage lifecycle and reuse but must not define Foundation contents.

external_contract_requirements.required_rule: Declare required and optional evidence artifact kinds and produced knowledge models.
Record executed analyzers and produced evidence artifacts without assigning their subject semantics.
Evidence meaning is selected by artifact_kind plus schema_version; task_id may remain execution provenance only.

purpose: Core-owned target contracts for the technical source index, independent evidence analyzers and typed evidence artifacts.
